text:
Sana: hey team — opened PR #1482 for observability: tracehook metrics rename + dashboard refactor. need one approver to hit today's canary window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1482 can someone take a quick look?

Otto: on it. quick q — did you change retention or increase cardinality anywhere?

Sana: no retention changes. main change is label normalization to collapse duplicate series (service -> svc, trimmed environment tag). also fixed a join in the panel query. snippet:
``
label_replace(redwood_trace_spans_total, "svc", "$1", "service", "(.*)")
```
should cut down series churn on the trace volume panel

Ria: i can preview the grafana panels in staging, give me ~15m

Lina: heads up — canary slot for console is at 21:30 UTC. if we miss it we move +7h. need merge by 21:10 to make the queue. if approved now i can trigger manual canary when ready

Sana: thanks. FYI CI had one flaky integration test earlier but i pushed a fix in the latest commit; CI will re-run

ci-bot: ci-bot: CI build #8829 queued for PR #1482 — running checks

Ria: looked at the panels and queries in staging. queries return correctly and the panels render with the new labels. no obvious perf regression in the sample window. approving from my side :+1:

Otto: LGTM. left one tiny nit about metric naming convention in a comment, not blocking. approving

Sana: amazing, thank you both. can someone merge when CI turns green? i'll have a rollback branch ready and will stand by for canary

ci-bot: ci-bot: CI build #8829 passed — all checks successful

Lina: merging now so the canary can pick this up. i'll post canary status in #incidents after the run

Lina: canary update: started, initial 10% rollout. seeing a small spike in worker memory on node-gpu-03 but it's within our alert thresholds (tracking). tagging @Sana

Sana: thanks — watching dashboards for 30m. will open a follow-up if anything drifts. ping me if we need to revert
